tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The HPE Aruba Networking CX 8325-32C is a powerful and scalable 100G Ethernet switch engineered for next-generation data center and enterprise core environments. Featuring 32 high-speed 100GbE QSFP28/QSFP+ ports, this switch delivers exceptional throughput, ultra-low latency, and non-blocking performance—ideal for modern cloud workloads, virtualization, storage networking, and large-scale enterprise infrastructures.


Powered by Aruba’s advanced AOS-CX network operating system, the CX 8325-32C offers fully programmable automation, real-time analytics, and stateful event-driven architecture. Network administrators benefit from simplified operations, faster troubleshooting, and enhanced reliability through built-in Network Analytics Engine (NAE), REST APIs, and consistent software architecture across the Aruba CX portfolio.


The switch supports EVPN-VXLAN, multi-chassis link aggregation (VSX), BGP, OSPF, VRF, QoS, and enhanced security controls—making it an ideal choice for campus cores, leaf-spine data center designs, and high-density 100G aggregation. Its redundant power supplies, smart fans, and enterprise-grade hardware ensure long-term stability and uptime for mission-critical networks.


For businesses in Bangladesh looking for a reliable, scalable, and future-proof 100G switch, the Aruba CX 8325-32C offers outstanding value and enterprise-level performance. Get authentic Aruba networking products from D CORE at the best market price.


Key Features

  • 32 × 100G QSFP+/QSFP28 ports for high-speed connectivity
  • Non-blocking switching capacity for data center-level performance
  • Aruba AOS-CX operating system with advanced automation
  • EVPN-VXLAN support for scalable Layer 2/Layer 3 fabrics
  • Aruba VSX for high availability and redundancy
  • Real-time analytics with Aruba Network Analytics Engine
  • Ideal for core, aggregation, and leaf-spine architectures
  • Ultra-low latency and high throughput for cloud & virtualization
  • Hot-swappable power supplies & fans for high uptime
  • Advanced security, QoS, telemetry, and programmability
